dialogue_texts: The sun is fully up. It seems your time in the parallel layer has completely run out for the night.
Ugh... don't rub it in. A whole night of flying, dodging, and blasting till my Mini Hakkero almost melted, and for what? Zero answers and a spectacular headache.
You pushed your magic to its absolute limit, Marisa. But the glohm in that distortion didn't just absorb your sparks - it actively fed on your blood. You were just spinning the wheels.
I've failed this cleanup job before dawn. That's just bad for me and royal business. I'm gonna lose my edge.
Look at your fingertips. The glohm didn't dissipate when the sun came up. It's now settling into your veins.
Tsk... it feels heavy like my magic trying to swim through mud. My head's spinning trying to force a basic light spell.
The glohm is anchoring itself inside you because we left the core intact. What is your next move? It will only burrow deeper if you leave it alone.
The next move is a closed sign on the palace door and about twelve hours of uninterrupted sleep. My fragile little mind can't take any more of this weird parallel logic...
Too bad! Bad ending! To see the good ending, clear the game without using a continue or letting nine hours pass.
